A method to deliver smooth, high-quality vide across various devices and network conditions.

The ABR Workflow

1. Create Versions

create multiple versions of the video at different quality levels(bitrates).

2. Chop into Chunks

Chop each version into small segments, usually a few seconds long.

3. Intelligently Switch

The player switches between quality levels to ensure smooth playback.

The ABR Kings

Two major protocols: HLS vs. DASH

HLS(HTTP Live Streaming)

Developed by Apple.

Uses .ts(Transport Stream) video segments and a text-based .m3u8 manifest file.

HLS organizes everything in a file called a manifest, and it ends in .m3u8

MPEG-DASH

Moving Picture Experts Group.

Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP.

An open, international standard. It typically uses .m4s segments and an XML-based .mpd(media presentation description) manifest file.

DRM

Digital rights management.

CMAF

The common media application format.

A standardized container format that allows you to use the same set of video files for HLS and DASH.

FFmpeg

A powerful, open-source tool that can transcode, segment, and generate manifests for ABR streaming.
